text:
Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar@MIshaqDar50spoke with UK Foreign Secretary H.E. Yvette Cooper@YvetteCooperMP. 

Foreign Secretary Cooper reiterated UK’s appreciation for Pakistan’s sustained efforts for peace and stability in the region
translated_text:
副首相/外交部长参议员穆罕默德·伊沙克·达尔@MIshaqDar50与英国外交大臣 H.E.伊薇特·库珀@YvetteCooperMP。 

外交大臣库珀重申英国赞赏巴基斯坦为该地区和平与稳定所做的持续努力

text:
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar@MIshaqDar50spoke to Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi@araghchilast night. 

DPM/FM reaffirmed Pakistan’s commitment to play its constructive role for achieving the goal of lasting peace and stability in the region
translated_text:
副总理兼外交部长参议员 Mohammad Ishaq Dar@MIshaqDar50 昨晚与伊朗外长 Abbas Araghchi@araghchi 进行了交谈。 

副总理/外长重申巴基斯坦致力于为实现该地区持久和平与稳定的目标发挥建设性作用

text: A magnitude 5.9 earthquake struck parts of Pakistan on Saturday evening, with tremors felt in several cities, according to the Pakistan Meteorological Department, which said the epicentre was located in Afghanistan’s Hindu Kush region at a depth of 178 kilometres.#Pakistan

translated_text: 伊朗革命卫队表示，他们对美国在海湾地区的地点发动了袭击，以报复美国在伊朗境内的袭击。美国军方表示，早些时候的袭击是为了回应霍尔木兹海峡一艘商船遭受的袭击。

text: According to a (Rtd) Indian Colonel Rajesh Power, Afghanistan is harbouring terrorists belonging to Fitna al-Hindustan and Fitna al-Khawarij, and India is providing financial support, while Israeli intelligence is also supporting these groups for terrorism in Pakistan.#Pakistan
